name: Charles Goerens - § 64
title: REPORT on financing for development – ahead of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development in Seville
part_text: Expresses concern over the increasing trend of tied aid, which reached EUR 4.4 billion (6.5 % of total bilateral ODA) in 2022, and calls for measures to reverse this trend and ensure that ODA primarily benefits partner countries rather than donor economies;
